description: Watch this video if you’re planning a trip to El Nido, Palawan 🇵🇭👀🛥️  let’s talk BOAT TOURS…. At first, I remember seeing ABCD everywhere and being so confused 😆 Here’s your key… 👇     Tour A: Iconic lagoons + kayaking 🛶 H#HighlightsKayaking through Big Lagoon, exploring Secret Lagoon, snorkeling at Shimizu Island, and relaxing on Seven Commandos Beach.  Tour B: Sandbars + caves 🏝️  Highlights: Walking the Snake Island sandbar, exploring Cudugnon and Cathedral Caves, and visiting beautiful Entalula Beach.  Tour C: Hidden beaches + snorkeling 🐠 Highlights: Discovering Hidden Beach and Secret Beach, visiting Helicopter Island, and snorkeling around dramatic limestone islands.  Tour D: Peaceful lagoons + quieter beaches 🌊 (furthest away) Highlights: Cadlao Lagoon and Small Lagoon, kayaking, and beach stops around Cadlao Island. A more relaxed route with fewer crowds.  Save this favorite trip to the Philippines + follow for more !! #Palawan #ElNido #Philippines #ElNidoBoat
